purpose: Serve familiar everyday meals on a board. Care remains the primary app utility.
status: editorial serving-guide drafts, not kitchen-tested recipes
preparationPolicy: Cooking guidance is optional. Accept the customer's usual recipe, store-bought shortcuts and already prepared food.
assemblyTimePolicy: Assembly minutes start after the food is cooked and ready. They are estimates, never total cooking times.
imagePolicy: Images are AI-generated inspiration; component photos are not calibrated to weight or portion counts.

templates.title: Gnocchi, Tomato & Basil
templates.description: Gnocchi with tomato and basil, with a few slices of bread alongside.
simpleIngredients: 1 cup prepared tomato sauce, or your usual sauce
A few slices of rustic bread
quickPrep: Cook the gnocchi following the package directions.
Warm your usual tomato sauce and toss with the gnocchi.
Add a few basil leaves. No homemade sauce is required.
servingSteps: Set the bowl of gnocchi on one side of the clean, dry board.
Lay a few slices of bread beside it, leaving room to reach the bowl.
Finish with basil and bring it to the table.
templates.layoutNote: Gnocchi stays in its bowl. Bread is the default accompaniment. Do not add a salad by default.

templates.title: Lemon Chicken & Potatoes
templates.description: Chicken, golden potatoes and a little green. An easy dinner to gather around.
simpleIngredients: 2 cooked chicken breasts, prepared your usual way
quickPrep: Use your usual cooked chicken and roasted potatoes; there is no special cooking method to learn.
Add a little lemon to the chicken if you like.
Use simply cooked green beans or another familiar vegetable.
servingSteps: Place the cooked chicken in a relaxed overlapping line.
Keep the potatoes together beside it, leaving a small gap.
Add the green beans and an optional lemon wedge.
templates.layoutNote: A cooked main, one familiar starch and one vegetable. Do not require garnish or additional homemade sauces.

templates.title: Steak & Roasted Potatoes
templates.description: Steak and golden potatoes with a fresh tomato-and-avocado side.
simpleIngredients: 2 cooked steaks, prepared your usual way
A little olive oil; lemon if you like
quickPrep: Use the steak and potatoes you already know how to cook.
Cut the tomatoes and avocado into chunks.
Dress lightly with olive oil and a little lemon if you like.
servingSteps: Set the tomato-and-avocado bowl near one corner.
Place the sliced cooked steak across the open center.
Group the potatoes beside it and leave each element easy to reach.
templates.layoutNote: Use the tomato-and-avocado bowl, never the old lettuce-and-cucumber bowl. Keep raw-meat preparation separate from the clean serving surface.

templates.title: Salmon, Rice & Beet Salad
templates.description: A simple salmon dinner with rice and a colorful beet-and-carrot side.
simpleIngredients: 2 small cooked beets; prepared beets are fine
Lemon and a little olive oil
quickPrep: Use your usual cooked salmon and plain rice.
Cut the cooked beets into wedges and shave the carrot into ribbons.
Toss the vegetables lightly with lemon and olive oil.
servingSteps: Set the rice and beet-and-carrot bowls near one side.
Place the cooked salmon beside them, with room to lift each portion.
Add the lemon wedges and bring it to the table.
templates.layoutNote: The stable template ID is retained for migration; the visible title changes. Replace the previous green-bean side with the beet-and-carrot bowl.

templates.title: Chicken Wraps
templates.description: Chicken wraps with a crisp cabbage-and-carrot side.
simpleIngredients: Lettuce and tomato for the wrap filling
A little plain yogurt or your usual dressing, optional
A little lemon and olive oil
quickPrep: Fill and roll the tortillas with cooked chicken, lettuce, tomato and optional dressing.
Cut each wrap into two halves.
Toss finely sliced cabbage and carrot with a little lemon and olive oil.
servingSteps: Set the four wrap halves with their cut sides visible.
Place the cabbage-and-carrot bowl beside them.
Leave a little space so the halves are easy to pick up.
templates.layoutNote: The wrap filling still contains lettuce and tomato. The side is cabbage and carrot, not lettuce and cucumber. Use two instances of the two-halves component.

templates.title: Tomato & Mozzarella Flatbread
templates.description: A simple pizza night with fresh tomatoes and basil alongside.
simpleIngredients: 2 small flatbreads or 1 large ready-made base
quickPrep: Top a ready-made base with tomato sauce and mozzarella; bake following the base manufacturer instructions.
Halve the cherry tomatoes and toss lightly with basil and olive oil.
Cut the flatbread into easy-to-share pieces.
servingSteps: Arrange the flatbread pieces in a relaxed fan or close to their original shape.
Set a small tomato-and-basil bowl to one side.
Leave room to lift each piece.
templates.layoutNote: Use only fresh tomato and basil in the side bowl. No default green salad; mozzarella stays on the flatbread.

implementationNotes: These are proposed new content IDs, not confirmed IDs in the existing app.
Keep serving guidance primary and quickPrep optional; do not require videos.
Do not generate new images for existing app ingredients already covered by earlier packages.
Do not add nutritional scores, calorie claims, ingredient gatekeeping or mandatory personalization questions.
Keep all previous presentations and recipes available in Discover; change their prominence rather than deleting them.
This package replaces v3 for these six default templates; it is not a patch requiring v3 uploads.
Do not insert a universal default green salad. Use the side chosen for each template.
Update covers, Designer defaults, steps and ingredient lists together.
Preserve user-created saved versions. Update built-in templates by stable ID without duplicating them.
componentInstances describes approximate visual module placement, not calibrated weights; adapt physical shopping quantities separately.
revisionNote: Full replacement of the six everyday serving ideas, with varied sides and matching covers. Preserve stable existing template IDs and upsert; do not add duplicates.
